acceptanceCriteria: Default top-level finish, archive, and close preserve their existing stdout JSON contract and render the complete persisted human Outcome on stderr with the fixed Outcome: 🟢/🟡/🔴 title, status, unknowns, evidence, human decision, and next action.

Explicit --json on finish, archive, and close suppresses the stderr human handoff without changing machine JSON; localized English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese rendering changes presentation only and preserves governance facts.
A blocked or fail-closed finish renders the already persisted red or yellow Outcome on stderr, returns the original nonzero status, and never fabricates success or authorization.

Runtime record_resource_finalization rejects before writing any canonical or transition decision when the archived Contract baseRevision differs from the receipt pullRequest.baseRevision; matching immutable bases retain existing behavior.

Runtime verify_resource_finalization, including canonical sequence=0, rejects an existing finalization chain when the archived Contract baseRevision differs from pullRequest.baseRevision and must not report verified for the exact WI-250 hosted-CI mismatch.
Regression tests cover record rejection with no decision file, sequence=0 verify rejection after receipt tampering, matching-base success, and unchanged transition/head/state fail-closed controls.

Tri-language workflow, commands, Outcome, capability, Work Item, and parity documentation state that archive freezes Contract baseRevision, provider finalization must bind the same PR base, and post-archive rebase requires fail-closed recovery rather than receipt rewriting.

The WI-250 recovery decision and imported predecessor archive/evidence/finalization retain exact bytes and bindings; parity projects WI-250 as recovered and WI-251 as the active successor without deleting PR #200 resources before successor close.

cargo fmt, clippy -D warnings, focused CLI and repository regressions, full locked workspace tests, tri-language documentation acceptance, parity, governance integrity, Runtime verification, visible human Outcome, archive, canonical finalization, hosted CI, reviewed merge, cleanup, and structured close all pass.
goal: 默认 lifecycle handoff 在保持 stdout JSON 兼容的同时直接输出完整人类 Outcome；机器 --json 模式抑制 handoff；blocked 路径保持 fail-closed；Runtime record/finalize-verify 对归档 Contract 与 PR base 绑定不一致一律拒绝，且归档后禁止通过 rebase 改变该绑定。
intent: 在不改写 WI-250 不可变归档、Outcome、验证与终结事实的前提下，从当前默认分支重新交付可见的人类 Outcome handoff，并修复 Runtime 未校验归档 Contract baseRevision 与 finalization pullRequest.baseRevision 一致性的根因。
outOfScope: PR #200 branch or worktree deletion before WI-251 close
static governance gate weakening or archived truth rewriting
MCP protocol schemas and GUI or dialog behavior
unrelated Work Items, pull requests, branches, worktrees, and root main
user-global Agent, Runtime, credential, or MCP configuration
